description: Conformance tests for KUHUL-FIELD.md §17-§18: four-graph training architecture and radius contract. Each test specifies a GML fragment, expected validator grade, and expected error codes. All tests run against gml.validator.json RD1-RD7 checks.

tests.name: radius_type_valid_graph_hops
tests.description: radius_type=graph_hops with radius=1 and no path_aggregation. Valid because radius=1 does not require path_aggregation.

tests.name: radius_type_invalid_string
tests.description: radius_type with unknown value must fail RD1.

tests.name: radius_hops_negative
tests.description: radius=-1 is invalid for graph_hops (topology distance is nonneg).

tests.name: radius_distance_zero
tests.description: radius_distance=0.0 is invalid for vector_distance (must be positive).

tests.name: radius_influence_out_of_range_zero
tests.description: radius_influence=0.0 is invalid for influence radius (must be in (0,1]).

tests.name: multihop_missing_path_aggregation
tests.description: radius=2 without path_aggregation. Must fail RD5 — path_aggregation required when radius > 1.

tests.name: radius_bound_not_access_grant
tests.description: radius field combined with commit_authority must fail RD6. RADIUS_BOUND != ACCESS_GRANT.

tests.name: radius_bound_not_semantic_authority
tests.description: radius field combined with semantic_authority must fail RD6.

tests.name: decay_mode_invalid
tests.description: decay_mode with unknown value must fail RD7.
tests.fragment: node [ id 1 radius_type "influence" radius_influence 0.1 decay_mode "gaussian" decay_rate 1.0 ]

tests.name: decay_rate_negative
tests.description: decay_rate=-0.5 is invalid (lambda must be nonneg in e^{-lambda*d}).
tests.fragment: node [ id 1 radius_type "influence" radius_influence 0.1 decay_mode "exponential" decay_rate -0.5 ]

tests.name: full_influence_radius_valid
tests.description: Complete influence radius declaration with decay. Should be VALID.
tests.fragment: node [ id 1 radius_type "influence" radius_influence 0.05 decay_mode "exponential" decay_rate 1.0 path_aggregation "max_product" ]

tests.name: trainer_topology_authority_separation
tests.description: trainer.gml gradient.propose node is candidate_only. GPU computation does not grant authority. GPU_RESULT != PROOF != AUTHORIZATION.
tests.fragment: node [ id 4 operator "arc.call" phase "sek" authority "candidate_only" gradient_mode "routing_guidance" training_step 0 grad_norm 0.0 ]
tests.note: GPU computes gradient speculatively. Ch'en verification required before XCFE admission.

tests.name: matryoshka_inactive_not_deleted
tests.description: is_active=0 is a valid working-set flag. The node exists; it is inactive, not deleted.

tests.name: tensor_compatibility_dimensions_positive
tests.description: dimensions must be a positive integer when present.
tests.note: dimensions=0 is inadmissible for vector/projection nodes; falls under existing tensor rank checks.

laws.TOPOLOGY_BEFORE_COORDINATES: radius_type=graph_hops is the primary radius kind — coordinates (x,y,z) are projection metadata
